task: Design a numerical Spark unit while retaining the supplied interpretation of impact, reach and capacity. Unsupported perception behavior stays a proposal.

character.name: Mira
character.scope: Supplied invented brief only; no outside canon.

documents.text: Mira fires a magical Spark at a detected enemy. She can aim along an unobstructed firing lane; sensing an enemy does not make the projectile travel through a wall. She is an original public character.

Use the explicit numerical Definition supplied by the btd6 preset. Retain projectile delivery and purchase gates. Impact, reach and target capacity are proposed design groupings, not additional source facts.

concepts.label: Spark identity
concepts.description: An aimed magical projectile requiring a clear delivery path.

concepts.label: Focused impact
concepts.description: Develop damage per hit while keeping the aimed projectile.

concepts.label: Extended reach
concepts.description: Develop attack reach without granting new detection or obstacle exceptions.

concepts.label: Crowd capacity
concepts.description: Develop finite target capacity while keeping clear delivery.

relationships.note: Proposed purchases modify different properties of the same attack.

layout.subject: Mira
design_invariants: Detection and attack delivery remain separate.
